$comment: The machine-readable half of this repository's advisory policy. The prose half is AUDIT-POLICY.md,
beside this file; a root SECURITY.md is a disclosure policy and is neither of them.
Enforced by `npm run security:audit` (scripts/audit-policy.mjs) and, offline, by
src/lib/__tests__/audit-policy.test.ts. Every entry needs a ghsa, a package, a reason of at least
80 characters that is not on FORBIDDEN_REASONS, a reach from {runtime, build, dev}, and a bare
YYYY-MM-DD expires that is still in the future. An EXPIRED entry FAILS the gate: that is the
mechanism that makes acceptance a decision which gets revisited rather than a permanent silence.
Two expiry horizons, and the rule is stated in AUDIT-POLICY.md: 30 days where a non-breaking fix
is measured available and blocked only by an in-repo gate, 90 days where the only fix is a
breaking major accepted on evidence that its input surface is never supplied.
Decision date for every entry below: 2026-08-25.

allowlist.reason: HTTP request smuggling in rewrites. next.config.ts declares no `rewrites` at all — its whole body is `output: "standalone"` plus `serverExternalPackages`, wrapped by next-intl's plugin — so the affected surface is not configured in this project. Accepted until 2026-09-24 pending the split follow-up: the fix is next 16.1.6 -> 16.3.2 (npm reports it as fixAvailable and NOT isSemVerMajor), measured in 47-08 against a scratch lockfile to clear next/postcss/sharp and join nothing at any severity. It is blocked in-repo rather than upstream: next@16.3.2 forces sharp ^0.35.3, whose @img/sharp-win32-ia32 caps engines.node at ^20.9.0, and src/lib/__tests__/node-engines-floor.test.ts:335 and :379 walk that range platform-blind against package.json:6's ">=24.12.0". The overrides{sharp:0.34.5} workaround was rejected because it contradicts next's own declared range and re-opens GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.

Unbounded next/image disk cache growth can exhaust storage. Measured 2026-08-25 over 702 source files under src/: ZERO import `next/image` and ZERO use `<Image`; the only textual match for next/image in the tree is the middleware matcher exclusion string `_next/image` at src/middleware.ts:8. next.config.ts declares no `images` block, so no remotePatterns are configured and the optimizer rejects external URLs. Reach is narrow rather than zero because the /_next/image endpoint still exists on the standalone server. Accepted until 2026-09-24 pending the split follow-up; the fix is next 16.3.2, blocked by the platform-blind engines walk at src/lib/__tests__/node-engines-floor.test.ts:335 and :379, and the overrides{sharp:0.34.5} workaround was rejected because it re-opens GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.

THIS ONE IS REACHABLE and is not being argued away: measured 2026-08-25, 23 files under src/ carry a top-level "use server" directive, so Server Actions are the project's primary mutation path. The disposition is therefore a scheduling decision, not a risk judgement: accepted until 2026-09-24 only because the fix is already measured and specified. next 16.3.2 clears it (47-08 resolved a candidate lockfile with `npm install --package-lock-only` and audited it: next/postcss/sharp all leave, nothing joins at any severity) and is blocked in-repo by src/lib/__tests__/node-engines-floor.test.ts:335 and :379 reading @img/sharp-win32-ia32's ^20.9.0 engines.node platform-blind against package.json:6.
